description: This file contains a library of functions shared by CI scripts, including environment setup, grouping, skipping logic, and CI-specific configurations. It manages different CI environments such as GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, providing utility functions for build optimization and artifact handling.

methods.name: begin_group
methods.description: Starts a new group in CI output, with different implementations depending on the CI environment.

methods.name: end_group
methods.description: Ends a CI output group, appropriate for the environment.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Wrapper that manages CI output groups around command execution.

methods.name: skip_branch_tip_with_tag
methods.description: Skips build if the current branch is at the tip of a tag, avoiding redundant builds.

methods.name: is_usable_git_repository
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a valid Git repository.

methods.name: save_good_tree
methods.description: Records current git tree hash and build info to allow skipping repeated builds.

methods.name: skip_good_tree
methods.description: Skips build if the current tree has been built and tested successfully before.

methods.name: check_unignored_build_artifacts
methods.description: Checks for unignored build artifacts that might interfere with clean builds.

methods.name: handle_failed_tests
methods.description: Placeholder for managing failed tests; implementation varies by CI environment.

methods.name: create_failed_test_artifacts
methods.description: Generates artifacts for failed tests, including logs and tarballs.
